build_RandAugment3d: build a python module to apply RandAugment3d random augmentations to a 4 channel RGBD tensor
build_ColorJitter3d: build a python module to apply ColorJitter3d color jitter augmentations to an RGBD tensor
build_DropChannels: build a python module to randomly drop channels from an RGBD tensor with configurable probabilities
build_DepthNorm: build a python module to normalize the depth channel of an RGBD tensor by max depth value
build_apply_op: build a python module to apply a named augmentation operation like ShearX or Rotate to a tensor
